headline: Index Rises, Share Prices of 67% of Companies Increase
summary: The DSEX index rose 38 points on Thursday, 17 September, as shares of 67% of companies trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange increased. Market capitalization also rose by 3,257 crore compared with the previous day.
why: The Dhaka Stock Exchange is Bangladesh's main equity market, and its DSEX index tracks broad share price moves in the country. Movements there reflect local investor sentiment and capital flows.
